primary_sources.supports: The USM GEMM overload accepts a queue, typed matrix pointers, scalar values, a compute mode and an optional dependency list.
Values are accepted for alpha and beta; raw host pointers are consumed at the call, while USM scalar pointers may be read after dependencies.
Per-call compute mode is explicit; default mode macros/environment can select alternate arithmetic, so the source candidate retains the existing deduction instead of adding faster arithmetic.

installed_source_observations: Original stack alpha/beta are normal host values and take the no-wait get_value path. No scalar transfer-wait bottleneck was found.
Same descriptor queue copy, transpose, dimensions, leading dimensions and native typed BF16/F16 to FP32 call are preserved.
Same compute_type f32 plus descriptor math_mode deduction is preserved; no MKL_BLAS_COMPUTE_MODE, reassociation or fast-math setting is changed.
Only known host scalars bypass the DPCT pointer-type/type-dispatch path. The unsupported buffer/library/HIP branches retain the original call.
The optional event dependencies are unchanged; no barrier, allocation or new ownership boundary is introduced.
